Bench_Cookie_Plus_8_French_Cleat_Holder..Description: <h2>French Cleat Holder for Bench Cookie Plus (8 pcs &amp; optional accessory holder mounting)</h2><h3>Note: This is the base holder for 8 bench cookies which hooks into the French cleat system. For the mounting of the optional accessory holder (risers), please print the separate model (<a target=&#34;_blank&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer ugc&#34; href=&#34;https://makerworld.com/en/models/1045169#profileId-1030832&#34;>here</a>) and glue the parts together.</h3><p>Over the years I accumulated several different types of bench cookies from different vendors. It was finally time to put them on the french cleat wall maintaining a consistent design.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>In the meantime it is confirmed by users that this design is also compatible with the Rockler-branded version of the Bench Cookie Plus.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>There are 2 versions available as separate print profiles:</p><ul><li><strong>Version 1: For usage with the optional accessory holder</strong>. This version contains the bottom interface structure and is generally printed with higher strength settings to hold the weight of the additional holder and the accessories</li><li><strong>Version 2: Standalone version</strong>. This version omits the bottom interface structure. Due to less structural load requirements it was further optimized to consume less material</li></ul><p>If you use the optional accessory holder, please make sure you do a proper deburring of the bottom of the top holder. I use brims in the supplied print profile to make the part as flat as possible, and a few minor sections of the interface channels are overlapping with these 6 brims. Make sure you clear the bottom channels, so the accessory holder can fit into it. You can then simply glue the parts together. The interface is designed to compensate for some z-tolerance and minor warping.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The provided print profile is optimized for PLA using custom supports - it took a few iterations of both the design and profile to make successful prints. I recommend to use the supplied profile.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><boostme><boosttitle>Boost Me</boosttitle><boostcontent>If you appreciate the work I am doing, please support me by leaving a boost. Thank you very much.</boostcontent></boostme>
Bench_Cookie_Plus_8_French_Cleat_Holder..ProfileDescription: <p>This version is stronger and intended for usage in combination with the optional accessory holder. If you don&#39;t need accessory holder, you can use the Standalone profile which saves material (and omits the interface structure at the bottom)</p><ul><li>0.2 mm layer height (adaptive), 3 walls, 12% infill</li><li>Custom tree supports</li><li>High quality print (low flow rate, brims for extra flatness for the accessory interface)</li></ul>

Bench_Cookie_Accesory_Extension_French_C.Description: <h2>Holder for Bench Cookie Plus - Optional Mount for Accessories</h2><h3><span style=&#34;color: #E14747&#34;>This is an add-on only: </span>In order to use it please also download corresponding holder from the table below. It <span style=&#34;color: #E14747&#34;>fits all 3 main variants (French Cleat, Wall Mount, IKEA Skadis)</span></h3><p>Over the years I accumulated several different types of bench cookies from different vendors and it was finally time to put them onto the wall. After the initial release of the French Cleat version I received requests for both wall mount and Skadis versions. So in the end this turned into a full portfolio of Bench Cookie Plus holders with different mounting options. Descriptions below are generic to all versions.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>In the meantime it is confirmed by users that this design is also compatible with the Rockler-branded version of the Bench Cookie Plus.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>If you use this optional accessory holder, please make sure you do a proper deburring of the bottom side of the top base holder. I use brims in the supplied print profile to make the parts as flat as possible, and a few minor sections of the interface channels are overlapping with these 6 brims. Make sure you clear the bottom channels of the top base holder, so this accessory holder can fit into it. You can then simply glue the parts together. The interface is designed to compensate for some z-tolerance and minor warping.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The holes for the risers are for ¾ inch (19 mm). If there is demand for a 20 mm version please let me know.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Note if you use the French Cleat version of the holder (not needed for Wall Mount nor Skadis): There are separate distance elements which can be glued on the rear to provide additional support (depending on the French cleat spacing they might not be needed). If you have a larger spacing (like on my pictures), I recommend to use it.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The provided print profile is optimized for PLA using very limited infill material. I used 3% and it worked perfectly, and this is really sturdy. Feel free to use more but it is not needed. I used 3 walls given the complexity of the shape with overhangs, and no supports are needed. Best to use the provided print profile which is tested to work perfectly. I print slowly (flow rate &lt; 11) to avoid warping and to get a good surface finish.</p><h3>Overview of available versions</h3><figure class=&#34;table&#34; style=&#34;width: 757.75px&#34;><table class=&#34;ck-table-resized&#34; While you only need to choose the correct mounting option (French Cleat, Wall Mount, Skadis) for the 4 pcs holders, for the 8 pcs holders you additionally need to decide if you need the optional accessory interface version (Standalone or with accessory interface)</li><li>The Standalone versions omit the bottom interface structure. Due to less structural load requirements it was possible to optimize the infill to consume less material. Furthermore, standalone versions are optimized by overall reduction in height and length (Skadis version only), significantly improving material consumption and print time (while maintaining the same high level of quality).</li></ul><p>As there are different types of Bench Dogs available from different vendors (Kreg, Rockler, Trend, MilesCraft, …), you can find other shapes also in this <a target=&#34;_blank&#34; rel=&#34;noopener noreferrer ugc&#34; href=&#34;https://makerworld.com/@user_2338539620/collections/4769170&#34;>collection</a>.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Have fun printing and I hope you enjoy my design.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><boostme><boosttitle>Boost Me</boosttitle><boostcontent>If you appreciate the work I am doing, please support me by leaving a boost.
